mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of 2% or more signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline of at least 1% in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >= 1% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise of at least 0.5 percentage points in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL within the same month signals a dual tightening of monetary policy and inflation, which erodes real purchasing power and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise >= 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase of at least 2% in real personal savings (RSAFS) combined with a concurrent decline of at least 1% in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals a shift from spending to saving, implying lower near-term demand and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises >= 2% and GDPC1 falls >= 1% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase of at least 0.4 percentage points in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a decline of at least 0.5% in industrial production (INDPRO) in the same month signals a simultaneous deterioration in labor and production conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >= 0.4% and INDPRO falls >= 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent annualized growth rate in housing starts (HOUST) below 500,000 units for four consecutive months signals a sustained weakness in the residential construction sector, which negatively impacts related industries and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.
